periods.summary: Kinji is teleported to Kasai and discovers child Rasputina under Moriarty's cloak, realizing Livia's curse reversed her age instead of simply erasing her.
periods.cause: Livia's interrupted Taty Biko Nasa curse and forced teleportation.
periods.process: Kinji finds a naked frightened dragon-horned child and identifies her as Rasputina.
periods.outcome: Kinji secretly transports her to Odaiba and begins acting as guardian.
periods.significance: Creates the central parent-child arc of volume 41.
